package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"strings"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/filters"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/queryfields"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// LessonRepoPG implements LessonRepository.
type LessonRepoPG struct {
	Pool *pgxpool.Pool
}

const lessonContentJoins = `
LEFT JOIN compose_config lc ON lc.id = l.compose_config_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT cm.course_id
    FROM module_section ms
    JOIN course_module cm ON cm.module_id = ms.module_id
    WHERE ms.section_id = lesson_context.section_id
      AND (lesson_context.module_id IS NULL OR ms.module_id = lesson_context.module_id)
    ORDER BY cm."order", ms."order"
    LIMIT 1
) course_scope ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT COALESCE(
        jsonb_agg(
            jsonb_build_object(
                'lesson_id', lv.lesson_id,
                'tech_version_id', lv.tech_version_id,
                'status', lv.status,
                'created_at', lv.created_at
            )
            ORDER BY lv.tech_version_id
        ),
        '[]'::jsonb
    ) AS versions
    FROM lesson_version lv
    WHERE lv.lesson_id = l.id
) lesson_versions ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT COALESCE(
        jsonb_agg(
            jsonb_build_object(
                'lesson_id', li.lesson_id,
                'i18n_id', li.i18n_id,
                'lang', i.language,
                'title', li.title,
                'excerpt', li.excerpt,
                'description', li.description
            )
            ORDER BY i.language
        ),
        '[]'::jsonb
    ) AS translations
    FROM lesson_i18n li
    JOIN i18n i ON i.id = li.i18n_id
    WHERE li.lesson_id = l.id
) lesson_i18n ON TRUE
`

const lessonGetPlacementJoin = `
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT sl.section_id, ms.module_id, NULL::uuid AS course_id, sl."order", sl.status
    FROM section_lesson sl
    LEFT JOIN module_section ms ON ms.section_id = sl.section_id
    WHERE sl.lesson_id = l.id
    ORDER BY ms."order", sl."order", sl.created_at, sl.id
    LIMIT 1
) lesson_context ON TRUE
`

// Create inserts lesson.
func (r LessonRepoPG) Create(ctx context.Context, lesson domain.Lesson) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	_, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO lesson (id, source_key, title, excerpt, description, compose_config_id, status, lesson_read_access, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ($1,NULLIF($2,''),$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8,$9,$10)`,
		lesson.ID, lesson.SourceKey, lesson.Title, lesson.Excerpt, lesson.Description, lesson.ComposeConfigID, lesson.Status, lesson.LessonReadAccess, lesson.CreatedAt, lesson.UpdatedAt)
	return mapPgError(err)
}

// Get fetches lesson.
func (r LessonRepoPG) Get(ctx context.Context, id string) (*domain.Lesson, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	row := runner.QueryRow(ctx, `
SELECT l.id, COALESCE(lesson_context.section_id::text, ''), COALESCE(lesson_context.course_id::text, course_scope.course_id::text, ''), l.title, l.excerpt, l.description, l.compose_config_id, lc.config, COALESCE(lesson_context."order", 0), l.status, l.lesson_read_access, l.created_at, l.updated_at
FROM lesson l
`+lessonGetPlacementJoin+lessonContentJoins+`
WHERE l.id=$1`, id)
	var l domain.Lesson
	if err := row.Scan(&l.ID, &l.SectionID, &l.CourseID, &l.Title, &l.Excerpt, &l.Description, &l.ComposeConfigID, &l.ComposeConfig, &l.Order, &l.Status, &l.LessonReadAccess, &l.CreatedAt, &l.UpdatedAt); err != nil {
		if err == pgx.ErrNoRows {
			return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
		}
		return nil, err
	}
	return &l, nil
}

// GetWithFields fetches lesson with selected fields.
func (r LessonRepoPG) GetWithFields(ctx context.Context, id string, f queryfields.Set) (map[string]any, error) {
	cols := columnsWithAliases(f, lessonFieldSQL)
	if len(cols) == 0 {
		cols = r.defaultLessonColumns()
	}
	selectCols := strings.Join(cols, ", ")
	query := fmt.Sprintf(`SELECT %s FROM lesson l %s %s WHERE l.id=$1`, selectCols, lessonGetPlacementJoin, lessonContentJoins)

	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	rows, err := runner.Query(ctx, query, id)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	if !rows.Next() {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}

	return ScanRowToMap(rows)
}

// Update updates lesson.
func (r LessonRepoPG) Update(ctx context.Context, lesson domain.Lesson) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	_, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `
	UPDATE lesson
	SET title=$1, excerpt=$2, description=$3, compose_config_id=$4, status=$5, lesson_read_access=$6, updated_at=now()
	WHERE id=$7`,
		lesson.Title,
		lesson.Excerpt,
		lesson.Description,
		lesson.ComposeConfigID,
		lesson.Status,
		lesson.LessonReadAccess,
		lesson.ID,
	)
	return mapPgError(err)
}

// Delete removes lesson by id (cascades to tasks via foreign keys).
func (r LessonRepoPG) Delete(ctx context.Context, lessonID string) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	_, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM lesson WHERE id=$1`, lessonID)
	return err
}

// ListByCourse lists lessons reachable from a course.
func (r LessonRepoPG) ListByCourse(ctx context.Context, courseID string) ([]domain.Lesson, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	rows, err := runner.Query(ctx, `
SELECT l.id, sl.section_id, cm.course_id, l.title, l.excerpt, l.description, l.compose_config_id, lc.config, sl."order", l.status, l.lesson_read_access, l.created_at, l.updated_at
FROM course_module cm
JOIN module_section ms ON ms.module_id = cm.module_id
JOIN section_lesson sl ON sl.section_id = ms.section_id
JOIN lesson l ON l.id = sl.lesson_id
LEFT JOIN compose_config lc ON lc.id = l.compose_config_id
WHERE cm.course_id=$1
ORDER BY cm."order" ASC, ms."order" ASC, sl."order" ASC, l.id ASC`, courseID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	var res []domain.Lesson
	for rows.Next() {
		var l domain.Lesson
		if err := rows.Scan(&l.ID, &l.SectionID, &l.CourseID, &l.Title, &l.Excerpt, &l.Description, &l.ComposeConfigID, &l.ComposeConfig, &l.Order, &l.Status, &l.LessonReadAccess, &l.CreatedAt, &l.UpdatedAt); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		res = append(res, l)
	}
	return res, rows.Err()
}

// ListBySection lists lessons in a section.
func (r LessonRepoPG) ListBySection(ctx context.Context, sectionID string) ([]domain.Lesson, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	rows, err := runner.Query(ctx, `
SELECT l.id, sl.section_id, course_scope.course_id, l.title, l.excerpt, l.description, l.compose_config_id, lc.config, sl."order", l.status, l.lesson_read_access, l.created_at, l.updated_at
FROM section_lesson sl
JOIN lesson l ON l.id = sl.lesson_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ms.module_id
    FROM module_section ms
    WHERE ms.section_id = sl.section_id
    ORDER BY ms."order"
    LIMIT 1
) section_module ON TRUE
JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT sl.section_id, section_module.module_id, NULL::uuid AS course_id, sl."order", sl.status
) lesson_context ON TRUE
`+lessonContentJoins+`
WHERE sl.section_id=$1
ORDER BY sl."order"`, sectionID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	var res []domain.Lesson
	for rows.Next() {
		var l domain.Lesson
		if err := rows.Scan(&l.ID, &l.SectionID, &l.CourseID, &l.Title, &l.Excerpt, &l.Description, &l.ComposeConfigID, &l.ComposeConfig, &l.Order, &l.Status, &l.LessonReadAccess, &l.CreatedAt, &l.UpdatedAt); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		res = append(res, l)
	}
	return res, rows.Err()
}

// ListByCourseFields lists lessons for a course with selected fields.
func (r LessonRepoPG) ListByCourseFields(ctx context.Context, courseID string, f queryfields.Set, lessonFilters filters.LessonFilters, sort *filters.SortOptions) ([]map[string]any, int, error) {
	query, args := r.buildListQuery(courseID, f, lessonFilters, sort)

	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	rows, err := runner.Query(ctx, query, args...)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	var res []map[string]any
	for rows.Next() {
		row, err := ScanRowToMap(rows)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, 0, err
		}
		res = append(res, row)
	}

	total, err := r.countListTotal(ctx, courseID, lessonFilters)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, err
	}

	return res, total, nil
}

func (r LessonRepoPG) countListTotal(ctx context.Context, courseID string, lessonFilters filters.LessonFilters) (int, error) {
	query, args, _ := r.buildListBaseQuery(courseID, "COUNT(*)", lessonFilters)
	var total int
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	if err := runner.QueryRow(ctx, query, args...).Scan(&total); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	return total, nil
}

func (r LessonRepoPG) buildListQuery(courseID string, f queryfields.Set, lessonFilters filters.LessonFilters, sort *filters.SortOptions) (string, []interface{}) {
	selectCols := r.selectLessonColumns(f)
	query, args, argIdx := r.buildListBaseQuery(courseID, selectCols, lessonFilters)

	hasCourseContext := strings.TrimSpace(courseID) != "" || lessonFilters.CourseID != nil
	hasModuleContext := lessonFilters.ModuleID != nil
	orderBy := `lesson_context."order" ASC, l.id ASC`
	if hasCourseContext {
		orderBy = `cm."order" ASC, ms."order" ASC, lesson_context."order" ASC, l.id ASC`
	} else if hasModuleContext {
		orderBy = `ms."order" ASC, lesson_context."order" ASC, l.id ASC`
	}
	if sort != nil {
		switch sort.Field {
		case filters.SortFieldCreatedAt:
			orderBy = fmt.Sprintf("l.created_at %s", strings.ToUpper(string(sort.Order)))
		case filters.SortFieldUpdatedAt:
			orderBy = fmt.Sprintf("l.updated_at %s", strings.ToUpper(string(sort.Order)))
		case filters.SortFieldTitle:
			orderBy = fmt.Sprintf("l.title %s", strings.ToUpper(string(sort.Order)))
		}
	}
	query += " ORDER BY " + orderBy

	_, limit, offset := filters.NormalizePagination(lessonFilters.Page, lessonFilters.Limit)
	query += fmt.Sprintf(" LIMIT $%d OFFSET $%d", argIdx, argIdx+1)
	args = append(args, limit, offset)

	return query, args
}

func (r LessonRepoPG) buildListBaseQuery(courseID string, selectCols string, lessonFilters filters.LessonFilters) (string, []interface{}, int) {
	var args []interface{}
	argIdx := 1

	if selectCols == "" {
		selectCols = r.selectLessonColumns(queryfields.Set{})
	}

	resolvedCourseID := strings.TrimSpace(courseID)
	if resolvedCourseID == "" && lessonFilters.CourseID != nil {
		resolvedCourseID = strings.TrimSpace(*lessonFilters.CourseID)
	}
	resolvedModuleID := ""
	if lessonFilters.ModuleID != nil {
		resolvedModuleID = strings.TrimSpace(*lessonFilters.ModuleID)
	}

	var fromSQL string
	moduleFilterApplied := false
	if resolvedCourseID != "" {
		fromSQL = fmt.Sprintf(`
	FROM course_module cm
	JOIN module_section ms ON ms.module_id = cm.module_id
	JOIN section_lesson sl ON sl.section_id = ms.section_id
	JOIN lesson l ON l.id = sl.lesson_id
	JOIN LATERAL (
	    SELECT sl.section_id, ms.module_id, cm.course_id, sl."order", sl.status
	) lesson_context ON TRUE
	%s
	WHERE cm.course_id = $%d`, lessonContentJoins, argIdx)
		args = append(args, resolvedCourseID)
		argIdx++
	} else if resolvedModuleID != "" {
		fromSQL = fmt.Sprintf(`
	FROM module_section ms
	JOIN section_lesson sl ON sl.section_id = ms.section_id
	JOIN lesson l ON l.id = sl.lesson_id
	JOIN LATERAL (
	    SELECT sl.section_id, ms.module_id, NULL::uuid AS course_id, sl."order", sl.status
	) lesson_context ON TRUE
	%s
	WHERE ms.module_id = $%d`, lessonContentJoins, argIdx)
		args = append(args, resolvedModuleID)
		argIdx++
		moduleFilterApplied = true
	} else {
		fromSQL = fmt.Sprintf(`
	FROM section_lesson sl
	JOIN lesson l ON l.id = sl.lesson_id
	LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
	    SELECT ms.module_id
	    FROM module_section ms
	    WHERE ms.section_id = sl.section_id
	    ORDER BY ms."order"
	    LIMIT 1
	) section_module ON TRUE
	JOIN LATERAL (
	    SELECT sl.section_id, section_module.module_id, NULL::uuid AS course_id, sl."order", sl.status
	) lesson_context ON TRUE
	%s
	WHERE TRUE`, lessonContentJoins)
	}

	query := fmt.Sprintf(`
	SELECT %s
	%s`, selectCols, fromSQL)

	var whereConditions []string
	if lessonFilters.ID != nil {
		whereConditions = append(whereConditions, fmt.Sprintf("l.id = $%d", argIdx))
		args = append(args, *lessonFilters.ID)
		argIdx++
	}
	if lessonFilters.CourseID != nil && resolvedCourseID == "" {
		whereConditions = append(whereConditions, fmt.Sprintf("cm.course_id = $%d", argIdx))
		args = append(args, *lessonFilters.CourseID)
		argIdx++
	}
	if lessonFilters.SectionID != nil {
		whereConditions = append(whereConditions, fmt.Sprintf("lesson_context.section_id = $%d", argIdx))
		args = append(args, *lessonFilters.SectionID)
		argIdx++
	}
	if resolvedModuleID != "" && !moduleFilterApplied {
		whereConditions = append(whereConditions, fmt.Sprintf("lesson_context.module_id = $%d", argIdx))
		args = append(args, resolvedModuleID)
		argIdx++
	}
	if lessonFilters.Title != nil {
		whereConditions = append(whereConditions, fmt.Sprintf("l.title ILIKE $%d", argIdx))
		args = append(args, "%"+*lessonFilters.Title+"%")
		argIdx++
	}
	if lessonFilters.Status != nil {
		whereConditions = append(whereConditions, fmt.Sprintf("l.status = $%d", argIdx))
		args = append(args, *lessonFilters.Status)
		argIdx++
	}

	if len(whereConditions) > 0 {
		query += " AND " + strings.Join(whereConditions, " AND ")
	}

	return query, args, argIdx
}

func (r LessonRepoPG) selectLessonColumns(f queryfields.Set) string {
	cols := columnsWithAliases(f, lessonFieldSQL)
	if len(cols) == 0 {
		cols = r.defaultLessonColumns()
	}
	return strings.Join(cols, ", ")
}

func (r LessonRepoPG) defaultLessonColumns() []string {
	return []string{
		"l.id",
		"lesson_context.section_id",
		"lesson_context.module_id",
		"COALESCE(lesson_context.course_id, course_scope.course_id) AS course_id",
		"COALESCE(lesson_versions.versions, '[]'::jsonb) AS versions",
		"l.title",
		"l.excerpt",
		"l.description",
		"COALESCE(lesson_i18n.translations, '[]'::jsonb) AS translations",
		"lc.config AS compose_config",
		`lesson_context."order"`,
		"l.status",
		"l.lesson_read_access",
		"l.created_at",
		"l.updated_at",
	}
}

var _ repository.LessonRepository = (*LessonRepoPG)(nil)
